messages:
alex: heads up — staging p95 jumped ~1.3x after onboarding checkpoint v3.1.4 this morning. CI perf also failing on model-onboard job. profiling attached.

sophia: rough timeline? which merges landed?

alex: merge 4f2d8c2 (tokenizer normalization) + runtime change c7a1b. I ran quick top-down profile. main hotspot is kernel_selector::score_candidates and batch_prefill

kevin: ugh batch_prefill? could be prefetch window default. any logs?

alex: ```text
[PROFILE] kernel_selector::score_candidates 45% p90
[PROFILE] batch_prefill::fill_window 28% p90
[PROFILE] kv_cache::prefill_miss 12% p90
[METRIC] p95_latency: baseline 180ms -> 236ms
[METRIC] gpu-sm-util: baseline 72% -> 88%
```

margo: @kevin can you kick a bisect on the runtime side? suspect change in kernel scoring after c7a1b. :eyes:

kevin: starting bisect across merges 4f2d8c2..c7a1b — will run shadow runs on staging. tagging infra-bot to reserve capacity.

infra-bot: reserved 6 x a100 for bisect window (staging) from 2025-11-18T09:30Z :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: perf CI: model-onboard PR #456 failed p95 > threshold (240ms) — job log https://ci/reports/456

kevin: early bisect: reverting tokenizer normalization (4f2d8c2) reduces batch_prefill time by ~40%. still investigating interaction.

sophia: could tokenizer change alter token lengths distribution -> different batching? maybe prefill window misestimates tokens-per-request

alex: good point. sample distribution shifted: avg input tokens from 18 -> 24 after checkpoint tokenization change. batch heuristic still tuned for 18.

margo: propose temporary rollout pause for v3.1.4 and revert runtime c7a1b in staging. Plan: revert runtime, update batching heuristic to consider tokens-per-request histogram. :warning:

kevin: creating PR to back out c7a1b and add a tunable env var BATCH_PREFILL_TARGET_TOKENS=20. Also adding unit tests for tokenizer length sampling.

alex: local test: setting BATCH_PREFILL_TARGET_TOKENS=22 brings p95 back to 188ms. Can we ship as hotfix? :+1:

margo: yes. mark rollout blocker and schedule emergency deploy. @ops to review.

ops-bot: emergency deploy window approved 10-min cooldown. will monitor traces.

kevin: PR link https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/789 — include revert + env var + test. CI green on smoke.

ci-bot: smoke passed. perf baseline run scheduled; will report p95 after deploy.

sophia: follow-up: we should add a telemetry histogram for tokenized input length per model variant. file an RFC?

alex: opened RFC #125: 'token-length telemetry + adaptive batch targets' — assigning to eng-runtime.
